alt.en: An old catalogue page. At left, in red gothic letters: "Model 43 Tandem, Price, $150, Weight 38 lbs." Beside it, paragraphs of text describe the machine, and below them is a drawing of a bicycle with two saddles and two sets of handlebars, one behind the other, with no riders. Page number 18.
alt.es: Una página de un catálogo antiguo. A la izquierda, en letras góticas rojas: "Model 43 Tandem, Price, $150, Weight 38 lbs." Al lado, varios párrafos describen la máquina y, debajo, hay un dibujo de una bicicleta con dos sillines y dos manillares, uno detrás del otro, sin nadie montado. Página 18.

caption.en: A bicycle built for two: the Model 43 tandem in the Columbia bicycle catalogue of 1895, three years after the song, which speaks of "the revival of interest in this class of machine" and offers it at $150.
caption.es: Una bicicleta hecha para dos: el tándem Model 43 del catálogo de bicicletas Columbia de 1895, tres años después de la canción, que habla del renovado interés por esta clase de máquina y lo ofrece por 150 dólares.

source: Columbia Bicycles (Boston: Pope Manufacturing Co., 221 Columbus Ave., 1895), trade catalogue, p. 18, "Model 43 Tandem"

alt.en: A sheet music cover with a pale green patterned border. In large red letters: "DAISY BELL", then "Song", "Written and Composed by", "HARRY DACRE". Below: "Song 4, Waltz 6", "New York, Published by T. B. Harms & Co.", "London: Francis, Day & Hunter", and a purple stamp of a music dealer in St. Paul, Minn.
alt.es: Portada de una partitura con un borde de dibujos verde claro. En grandes letras rojas: "DAISY BELL", y luego "Song", "Written and Composed by", "HARRY DACRE". Debajo: "Song 4, Waltz 6", "New York, Published by T. B. Harms & Co.", "London: Francis, Day & Hunter" y un sello morado de un comercio de música de St. Paul, Minnesota.

caption.en: The cover of Daisy Bell, "Written and Composed by Harry Dacre", published by T. B. Harms of New York and Francis, Day and Hunter of London, copyright 1892: the copy our arrangement is read from.
caption.es: La portada de Daisy Bell, "Written and Composed by Harry Dacre", publicada por T. B. Harms, de Nueva York, y Francis, Day and Hunter, de Londres, con copyright de 1892: el ejemplar del que sale nuestro arreglo.

source: Harry Dacre, Daisy Bell, song (New York: T. B. Harms & Co.; London: Francis, Day & Hunter; copyright 1892), cover; this copy printed 1893 or later

alt.en: A printed page of music headed "CHORUS." and "A little faster.", page 5: a vocal line with piano below, in four rows, with the words "Daisy, Daisy, Give me your answer, do! I'm half crazy, All for the love of you! It won't be a stylish marriage, I can't afford a carriage, But you'll look sweet On the seat Of a bicycle built for two!"
alt.es: Una página de música impresa con el encabezado "CHORUS." y "A little faster.", página 5: la línea de canto con el piano debajo, en cuatro filas, con la letra "Daisy, Daisy, Give me your answer, do! I'm half crazy, All for the love of you! It won't be a stylish marriage, I can't afford a carriage, But you'll look sweet On the seat Of a bicycle built for two!"

caption.en: Page 5 of the same copy: the chorus, marked "A little faster", printed once after the three verses and ending "Of a bicycle built for two!"
caption.es: La página 5 del mismo ejemplar: el estribillo, marcado "A little faster" (un poco más rápido), impreso una sola vez después de las tres estrofas y terminado en "Of a bicycle built for two!"

source: Harry Dacre, Daisy Bell, song (New York: T. B. Harms & Co.; London: Francis, Day & Hunter; copyright 1892), p. 5, "Chorus"; this copy printed 1893 or later
